prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a low-speed head-on collision claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1371; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received for a low-speed head-on collision. Insured reports vehicle struck on front end; other driver's vehicle also sustained front-end damage. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles uploaded to file.

Entry 2: Claimant reports neck and back strain following impact and is now represented by counsel. All further contact to be routed through the attorney's office. Letter of representation on file. Recorded statement from insured obtained; liability facts consistent with initial report.

Entry 3: Medical records requested from claimant's treating provider via authorization forwarded by counsel. Diagnosis noted as cervical and lumbar strain. Treatment plan includes physical therapy. Reviewing prior treatment history per counsel's disclosure.

Entry 4: Independent appraisal completed on claimant's vehicle. Repair estimate reviewed and found within normal range for the damage described. Rental coverage confirmed under insured's policy terms. Supervisor review requested before final settlement evaluation.

Entry 5: Demand package received from claimant's counsel and under review. Medical bills and wage documentation listed. File flagged for evaluation of liability split and bodily injury valuation. Follow-up with counsel scheduled to confirm missing records.
